title: ci: Bump all the macOS builder images
body:
## PR summary

Since macOS 14 seems to no longer be supported, Homebrew has been dropping pre-built packages for it as they are updated. Based on [statistics from Pillow](https://discuss.python.org/t/moving-packaging-and-installers-to-macos-10-13-as-a-minimum/31907/8) (which is one of our dependencies), 10.14 and below just barely summed to 0.1% of usage in December 2024, so we should be safe to stop testing on it.

Fixes #32339
